Appearance:
 Shri Javed Khan - advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Hemant Sharma - Ga for the State.
 Order

This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.94/2024,
dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station- Rajod, Tehsil Sardarpur District-Dhar (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under sections 363, 366, 366-A, 376, 376(2) (N), 376(3), 506,
120(B) of the IPC and sections %L/6 of the POCSO Act.
After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application.
The other side has no objection.
M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Jiten @ Jitendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19899061/
